title: Account store: binding to an external provider's subject, and durable authorization records
spec: Account records tag 11 ExternalBound (email, issuer, subject) and tag 12 AuthorizationRecorded (email and the whole crewcraft_authz::Record: optional grant with capability names, revision, confirmed_at and fresh_until; optional denied revision; highest revision; next check). bind_external requires a canonical email of an existing person and non-empty issuer and subject; a (issuer, subject) bound to another person is ExternalInUse; re-binding replaces the person's earlier binding and frees it; person_for_external and external_of read both ways; everything survives reopening. The store implements crewcraft_authz::Ledger: commit appends an AuthorizationRecorded record (only for an existing person) and applies it; read_back returns the applied record and refuses while the store is poisoned; so commit_decision grants nothing for an unknown person, and a stored denial still refuses after a restart. Both records round-trip, every prefix fails to decode, and an unknown capability name in a stored record is FieldLength. Debug shows the email and whether there is a grant or denial, not the capabilities or revisions.
